_comment: Hand-maintained. Vinted is read from its UK storefront, so everything already arrives in
British English and nothing here translates any more.
categories: Vinted sends a flattened breadcrumb string like 'Women Necklaces' or
'Home Ornaments'. Matching is longest-prefix, so 'Women' catches the whole women's
branch while 'Women Necklaces' overrides it for jewellery. Add a rule only when
sync-vinted.mjs reports an unmapped branch at the end of a run — never by going
Spirituality and Wellness have no equivalent in Vinted's tree. Those are curatorial,
not structural, so they are assigned per item in overrides.json, which always wins.
conditions/colors: pass-through maps kept only to force British spellings on the few
words Vinted ships in American English.
_sizes_comment: Vinted returns a compound size like 'L / 40 / 12' (UK / EU / US). Shoppers filter on
the letter, so sync-vinted.mjs takes the part before the first slash and maps it here.
